briefdescription.para: Continuous Batch Scheduler for LLM Inference.

detaileddescription.para:
Implements vLLM-style continuous batching with the following features:
Iteration-level scheduling (Orca-style)
Chunked prefill (Sarathi-Serve-style)
Request priority queues
Adaptive batch sizing
Preemption support
Statistics tracking
This scheduler is designed for per-shard inference in a converged storage-retrieval-inference architecture.
